status: REGISTERED - owner-approved, signed off and on the blackboard; approved for ONE confirmatory look

owner_decisions.note: values approved by the owner; the file stays DRAFT and unsigned until sign-off and blackboard registration

hypothesis: On the R7 holdout sessions, the DeepLOB classifier (iap.models.deeplob_torch.DeepLOBClassifier, arch 'deeplob') earns a positive mean net-of-cost P&L per non-overlapping taker trade, with a one-sided 95% lower bound above zero, and a higher mean than both baselines on the same features and split.
insample_role: insample days of research/r7/r7_candidates.json (training and model selection only)

dataset.sampling_clock: event: one step per order-book event
dataset.training: pooled across AAPL, MSFT, QQQ (one model; owner decision 2026-10-11)
dataset.evaluation: acceptance reported per symbol and pooled

acceptance.metric: iap.models.deeplob_baselines.net_of_cost (taker, non-overlapping trades), costs from the platform cost model including SEC Section 31 and FINRA TAF regulatory fees

cost_model.note: not a flat fee_bp: load_exec_config(..., regulatory_fees=True) as configs/prereg/v2.json prescribes

acceptance.unit: per symbol; the hypothesis holds only if it is accepted on every symbol (no pooling across symbols after the fact)

looks: one confirmatory look on the holdout; any re-run counts as a new look in the ledger
promotion: none without a holdout pass; a pass makes AI4 eligible for review, not promoted

registration.approval: owner approved the final text in chat on 2026-10-11 and delegated sign-off/registration; registration run by the owner
registration.holdout_note: no holdout data (data/real/itch/r7 S1128*, S120*, S121*, S0612*) was read, decompressed or ingested before this registration; only the sha256/bytes of the compressed files recorded in the draft were computed
registration.path: iap.agents.broker.WriteBroker.preregister (human writer, as the v1.8 holdout preregs; one look debited each on research/experiments.json)
